resources.string: Looks at GitHub once a day and sends a notification when a new version is out
You are on %1$s. Tap to update.
Should I tell you about new versions?
Once a day FitWren looks up the latest version number on GitHub and sends a notification when a new version is out. None of your data is sent. You can change this later in Settings → About.
You are on %1$s. The update comes from GitHub and your data stays where it is.
